data.title: Showing Numbers Two Ways
data.description: Explore teen numbers and single-digit numbers by building them with tens and ones blocks in more than one way.

challenges.instruction: Show 20 with blocks. Then show 20 a different way.
challenges.hint: A big block can be swapped for the smaller blocks it is worth.
